payload.title: P6-02: Pilobol.us: create the CMS and reader apps in papyrus-production (domain-free), GitHub App, repairs, first build
payload.description:
## Goal
Google sign-in works at the new CMS default URL against the new pool, using the EXISTING Pilobolus Google client (project 472527967203), with the legacy sign-in untouched.

## Context (FACT)
- Per-site Google projects are the standard (Ryan, 2026-10-07). The new pool's Cognito domain differs from the legacy one, so the only Google-side change is two additive entries on the SAME client: authorized JavaScript origin `https://papyrus-pilobol-us-cms.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com` and authorized redirect URI `https://papyrus-pilobol-us-cms.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/idpresponse`. Site hostnames never appear in Google (Cognito brokers). Keep the legacy hex-domain entries until the retire ticket so legacy sign-in and rollback keep working.
- Google limits unverified domains per project to 10 and each Cognito prefix counts as a domain: before adding, list the entries on the client; Ryan removes entries of already-retired pools (the old CMS d11eu9hbs2mipk pools: prefix papyrus-pilobol-us, hex 4f95152b62f48bfd084b) if the count is near the limit.
- SSM secrets path in the new account: /amplify/<newCmsAppId>/main-branch-<first 10 hex of sha512(appId + branch)>/GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET (compute the path with the helper used for p.apyr.us, then verify by name against the legacy path pattern).

## Exact steps
1. Ryan (Google console, project 472527967203): add the two entries above to the existing client.
2. Copy GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET from the legacy SSM path of dv0pdx67fk80m to the new path in papyrus-production by piping (`get-parameter --with-decryption` into `put-parameter --type SecureString`), never printing; verify names, types, and that the client id prefix (project number) is 472527967203 without printing the id.
3. Rebuild the CMS main job (the IdP configuration reaches Cognito on the backend deploy). Verify with `describe-user-pool-client`: callback and logout URLs include `<default origin>/`, `<default origin>/newsroom` and localhost; supported IdP includes Google.
4. Ryan signs in with Google at the new default URL (private window); then `admin-add-user-to-group` for the first admin in the NEW pool (users do not move; the legacy pool has one external-provider admin).

## Acceptance checks
- Sign-in round trip lands on the newsroom; the user is in the admin group; legacy https://newsroom.pilobol.us sign-in still works; no secret printed.

## Rollback
Remove the two Google entries; delete the SSM parameters in production. Legacy is unaffected.

## Needs Ryan
Google console edits, the sign-in, removal decisions for old entries.

## Common rules (Phase 6, PPY-7d8cd0)
- Read /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus/AGENTS.local.md first. Assert the account with `aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text` before EVERY call: profile legacy = 335163751677, profile papyrus-production = 712236451410. Never use papyrus-development; papyrus-staging (494166748521) is not used by this phase.
- Every write needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Legacy is READ-ONLY except the steps this ticket names (each with a yes). No SCPs on legacy; never risk legacy access; no `cdk deploy` and no `ampx` against the legacy stacks of these sites.
- Never print secret values (names only; SSM values move by pipe, never to the terminal or a ticket). Ryan deletes retired resources. Do not touch Anth.us production d2hbn1ig6nqyhy or the other anth.us apps (apricity d2n7w4kwqyfwn4, babulus d3epcqvzbxdaq, tactus dfkbdffs2viq8, primus divicqm3nhcwt).
- Baselines and scratch live under /Users/home/Projects/.baselines/phase6-<date>/ (outside any repo); clones go under /Users/home/Projects/ and are deleted afterwards (disk is tight). Only kbs writes in the Papyrus checkout (never git add/commit there); never `git stash`.
- The committed infra/site.json in each site repo still describes the LEGACY stack until the cutover ticket; production deploys use an out-of-repo, domain-free copy (as PPY-aa93b3 did for p.apyr.us).
